caption: The drawing is centered on a plain, beige background that appears slightly textured with several brownish stains scattered across the paper. The object depicted is a black bracelet made up of two rows of small, round, faceted black stones. At the center of the bracelet, there are two larger, round, faceted black stones placed vertically, with one above the other, dominating the design. The arrangement of stones is symmetrical, and the bracelet appears to be closed or joined where the two larger stones meet. The composition is minimal, with the bracelet as the sole object in the center of an otherwise empty space.
title: Bracelet
